answer: Promotion out of probation presupposes 12 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. Because the summit record is per identity, the vault audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, because every alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's signal standing. That is 23 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
